description: IUB_Astra is a collaborative team exploring Earth system trends through technology, data, and innovative problem-solving.
summary: EarthPulse is an app (Android, iOS and web, in English and Bangla) that turns 40+ years of NASA data into plain advice for your day and real statistical proof of how your own place is changing. It helps everyday people, such as farmers, commuters and students, decide what to do today, and teaches young people to tell a real climate signal from noise. It reads your location, combines the live forecast with NASA POWER climate records, runs Sen's slope and Mann-Kendall trend tests, and explains each result in one plain sentence. A detective game, a research desk and a live NASA event newsroom make trend detection something anyone can learn.
details:
USE OF AI (SI)

- Narration in our videos is an AI voice (Supertonic TTS by Supertone, OpenRAIL-M). The demo video carries a visible "SI-assisted" watermark and the disclosure in its metadata and description.

- App code was generated and edited with Apper (AI app builder) and Claude (Anthropic) from our prompts. We chose every feature and checked every result against live NASA data.

- Claude also helped write the video scripts, the game design research and this text, and assembled the videos.

- Music was synthesised in code (no AI music tool). The rain and the nearby khichuri place in the demo are simulated, as stated on screen.

- The app itself uses no AI: every number comes from NASA data and standard statistics.
dataRefs: NASA POWER: Air temperature at 2 m (T2M, T2M_MAX), MERRA-2
NASA POWER: Earth skin temperature (TS) and relative humidity (RH2M)
NASA POWER: All-sky surface shortwave radiation (ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN), CERES
NASA EONET v3: Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker
NASA GIBS: MODIS Terra and VIIRS SNPP true colour, VIIRS Day/Night Band
NASA GIBS: MODIS land surface temperature, aerosol, snow cover, Aqua chlorophyll-a
